paper.title_en: Demonstration: An Interactive Bench for Symbolic Models of Quantum Protocols
paper.abstract_en: Symbolic verification depends on the model and the property being checked. We demonstrate a local bench for working with Tamarin models of quantum protocols. Users can change model settings, inspect and edit the generated theory, and compare lemma results. We first check executability in a prepare-and-measure quantum key distribution model. We then use a separate send model to show what happens when its preshared key is exposed. Secrecy and message correspondence fail, but executability still holds. Two built-in proof-search heuristics give the same verdicts. The bench lets attendees trace each result to the model and property that produced it.
